name: Meza Scholars vocabulary bank
source: Unique words merged from three publicly shared Anki decks Sebastian chose (Nov 24, 2026): '1000 SAT word list' (deck 1), 'SAT vocabulary 1000 words' (deck 2), and 'SAT Vocab Power Deck: 500 Essential Words' (deck 3). Only the words and parts of speech are kept; no definitions, example sentences, or audio from the decks. Inflected forms were reduced to base forms (lemminflect), a few misspellings fixed, and duplicates merged. tier = English word frequency (wordfreq zipf): advanced < 3.0 <= mid < 3.8 <= common. multi_meaning = the deck marks a second or numbered meaning, used to pick tested words for underlined-word items. Replaces the earlier Barron's-based vocab_bank.json.
